 11-11 Shopping Day: The price war on e-commerce platforms
 The 11-11 shopping day continues to heat up the online retail market as e-commerce platforms simultaneously launch discount codes, shipping offers, and timed sales programs.
 Hà Nội Mới • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Platforms are simultaneously launching promotions to attract customers. 
 According to observations, from the evening of November 10th to 11th, many promotional programs on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop entered their peak phase. On these apps, fashion products, cosmetics, household goods, and electronic devices were featured with discount codes, shipping offers, and live streaming sessions. The shopping atmosphere was vibrant, but to secure orders at good prices, customers had to pay attention to both the timing and the terms and conditions of using the codes.
 It's not just items costing a few tens or hundreds of thousands of dong that are being discounted; high-value electronics and household appliances are also participating in the race. During a livestream, an air purifier was offered at a price reduced from over 3.9 million dong to around 2.32 million dong. Another phone was advertised at over 18.3 million dong, approximately 8.84 million dong lower than its pre-discount price. 
 Cosmetic products are discounted during the 11-11 shopping event on e-commerce platforms. Photo: Le Ha On Shopee, the "11.11 Biggest Sale of the Year" runs from October 26th to November 13th, offering numerous discount codes and shipping fee support. The platform also promotes SPayLater vouchers with discounts up to 11 million VND.
 Lazada is launching its "11.11 Mega Sale" campaign from 8 PM on November 10th to November 13th. The platform is offering vouchers with discounts up to 11 million VND, up to 20% off branded products, and special sales events at 0 AM, 12 PM, and 7 PM. Livestreaming and official brand stores are also being promoted to attract buyers of technology, beauty, and household products.
 You may also like Meanwhile, TikTok Shop continues to leverage the advantages of short videos and livestreams. Products are showcased live, accompanied by discount codes or limited-time offers, allowing viewers to purchase immediately during the broadcast. This sales method offers convenience but can also lead users to make quick decisions when they see notifications that the discount code is about to expire or the item is out of stock.
 Think more carefully before closing the deal. 
 The 11-11 sale remains an opportunity for many people to buy items they've planned to purchase. However, the fact that promotions happen almost year-round also makes many customers less hasty, instead of placing orders immediately upon seeing deep discounts. 
 Consumers select products on e-commerce platforms during the 11-11 shopping event. Photo: Le Ha. Mr. Nguyen Thanh Binh, an employee at a media company in Hanoi , said he waited for the 11-11 shopping event to buy a wireless keyboard and mouse set for work. After researching and comparing prices at many stores, he decided to choose the Logitech MK295 Silent set at a promotional price of 649,000 VND, a discount of 250,000 VND compared to the listed price of 899,000 VND, equivalent to nearly 28%. Mr. Binh shared that this discount was quite attractive, helping him save a significant amount of money. In particular, the product met his needs, had a reputable brand, and a clear warranty policy, so he was very satisfied. According to him, shopping during promotional events is truly beneficial if consumers proactively research, compare prices, and choose necessary products instead of just chasing discount programs.
 Meanwhile, Ms. Tran Thu Huyen, a bank employee in Hanoi, chooses to buy laundry detergent, shampoo, and some essential household items. She usually makes a list before opening the app, prioritizing familiar brands and checking the total price after adding shipping fees. According to her, even a heavily discounted item isn't a saving if you buy it and then leave it unused because you don't need it yet.
 According to YouNet ECI data for Q3 2026, 74% of consumers prioritize product quality, 67% are concerned about price, while the percentage valuing promotions decreased from 53% to 46%. This indicates that buyers are increasingly considering their options, rather than being solely attracted by discounts.
 You may also like In reality, the prices listed on online marketplaces may not accurately reflect the prevailing selling prices, while many discount codes come with terms and conditions. Therefore, consumers need to compare prices, check product origins, and review warranty and return policies before making a purchase.
 For retailers, promotions help increase orders and attract customers, but they also entail costs for advertising, shipping, and handling returns. Therefore, balancing sales and profit is a significant challenge in the price war.
 The 11-11 shopping day continues to contribute to stimulating consumer spending at the end of the year. However, attractive discounts need to be coupled with product quality, transparent pricing, and after-sales service to bring real benefits to buyers and retain customers.
